builder: the menu starts with your apps and asks about local AI only when it matters -- YOUR APPS comes first (the menu opens on the first one), then MAKEPAD EXPERIMENTS (one row opening the list), CODING AGENTS, and SETUP last with only Account, Graphics, Agreements, Disk and Update. The Build tools, Rust, Xcode tools/System packages and CUDA rows are gone, and nothing is installed at the start: an app sets up what it needs when it is first built, as it already did. Windows has two modes, recorded in selected-compiler and never switched afterwards: no local AI with Rust's GNU toolchain, or local AI with Microsoft's Build Tools, the Windows SDK and CUDA. Only the first build of an app with CUDA features on a PC with an NVIDIA driver asks, on one "› Local AI" page: the NVIDIA, Microsoft Build Tools and Windows SDK agreements (Return opens one in the browser), then "Agree and enable local AI" (selected) and "No local AI"; Escape goes back to the menu without deciding. Without an NVIDIA driver, for other apps and on macOS/Linux nobody is asked. makepad.sh gets the same order; its first_license_row no longer pipes the menu into sed ...q, which with YOUR APPS on the first line closed the pipe under main_rows' printf and stopped the Builder. Checked: cargo check for the host and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu without warnings, the lib tests, and makepad.sh in a pty with a scratch HOME through log-in, folder, the menu and the experiments list
